note.zh-TW: Gomaji 是台灣的在地生活優惠服務；App 與優惠碼在台灣以外是否可用，本站未確認。
note.en: Gomaji is a Taiwan local-life deals service; whether the app and promo code work outside Taiwan was not checked.

Gomaji 官方說明頁（點數與邀請碼）
label.en: Gomaji help page (points and invite codes)

label.zh-TW: App Store：Gomaji 懂生活的好麻吉

title.zh-TW: 首次下載 App 並輸入優惠碼，可得 120 點（依分享文案）
title.en: Enter the promo code on a first app download and get 120 points (per the share text)

text.zh-TW: 邀請頁標題寫 100 點、內文寫 120 點（本站依內文與分享文案）。1 點 = NT$1，入帳後 30 天內有效，折抵上限為折扣後商品金額的 10%；實際內容、金額與期限以官方公告為準。
text.en: Page title says 100 points, body 120 (this site uses 120). 1 point = NT$1; valid 30 days; offsets up to 10% of the discounted amount. Official terms prevail.

steps.zh-TW: 點擊「立即註冊」：本站會先複製優惠碼 GHKQF，再開啟 Gomaji 邀請頁（gmj.tw 短網址，會轉到 gomaji.com）。
steps.en: Select “Sign up”: this site copies promo code GHKQF, then opens the Gomaji invite page (a gmj.tw short link that leads to gomaji.com).

steps.zh-TW: 依頁面指示下載 Gomaji APP（分享文案寫明使用最新版）；如 App 要求，請先註冊或登入。
steps.en: Follow the page to download the Gomaji app (the share text says to use the latest version); register or log in first if the app asks you to.

steps.zh-TW: 在 App 的「功能列 / 我的 / 賺取點數 / 輸入優惠碼」貼上 GHKQF；若沒有貼上，請依原樣手動輸入。
steps.en: In the app, open 功能列 / 我的 / 賺取點數 / 輸入優惠碼 (menu / Me / Earn points / Enter promo code), then paste GHKQF or type it in exactly as shown.

steps.zh-TW: 確認點數已入帳；實際點數、可折抵的範圍與有效期限，以官方公告為準。
steps.en: Check that the points arrive; the actual amount, how far they offset a purchase and when they expire follow the official announcements.

intro.zh-TW: 依分享文案與邀請頁內文，首次下載 Gomaji APP 並輸入優惠碼 GHKQF 可得 120 點（邀請頁標題寫 100 點；1 點 = NT$1）。
intro.en: Per the share text and invite page body, enter promo code GHKQF on a first Gomaji app download for 120 points (the page title says 100).

description.zh-TW:
Gomaji（懂生活的好麻吉，品牌也寫作夠麻吉）是台灣的在地生活優惠平台，提供網站與 App，販售餐飲、旅遊等優惠票券。本站的連結是 Gomaji 的短網址（gmj.tw），不含優惠碼：點擊「立即註冊」時，本站會先複製優惠碼 GHKQF，再開啟 Gomaji 的邀請頁。

依分享文案與邀請頁內文，首次下載 Gomaji APP 並輸入優惠碼 GHKQF，可得 120 點（邀請頁標題寫 100 點）。依 Gomaji 官方說明頁，1 點等於 NT$1，點數不可轉讓或兌換現金。實際內容、金額與期限以 Gomaji 官方公告為準。
description.en:
Gomaji (懂生活的好麻吉, also written 夠麻吉) is a local-life deals platform in Taiwan with a website and an app, selling discounted vouchers for dining, travel and similar. The link on this page is a Gomaji short link (gmj.tw) and does not carry the promo code: selecting “Sign up” first copies promo code GHKQF, then opens the Gomaji invite page.

According to the share text and the invite page body, entering promo code GHKQF on a first app download gives 120 points (the invite page title says 100). Gomaji’s help page says 1 point equals NT$1, and points cannot be transferred or cashed out. Actual terms, amounts and deadlines follow Gomaji’s official announcements.

notes.zh-TW:
此連結（gmj.tw/fPumY）不含優惠碼，請在 App 的「輸入優惠碼」貼上或手動輸入 GHKQF（依原樣輸入）。本站沒有測試 App 是否會自動帶入，也沒有實際註冊測試優惠碼是否被接受。

分享文案寫「現賺$120點直接折抵」，這裡的金額是點數，不是現金。邀請頁標題寫「現賺$100」，內文寫「現賺 $120」，頁面沒有解釋差異；本站依分享文案與邀請頁內文寫 120 點，實際金額以 Gomaji 官方公告為準。

邀請頁寫「首次下載 APP」，沒有說明活動期限，也沒有說明重新安裝的使用者是否適用。官方說明頁提醒，違規使用邀請碼可能被停用帳號並回收點數。

gmj.tw 是 Gomaji 的短網址：官方說明頁用它當下載 App 的連結，2026-10-24 以瀏覽器開啟 gmj.tw/fPumY 也確認會轉到 gomaji.com/invite?code=GHKQF；網域的註冊資料沒有查證。短網址的終點可由擁有者變更，請在繼續前確認最終網址。依 Gomaji 服務條款，未滿 18 歲須經法定代理人閱讀並同意條款。
notes.en:
This link (gmj.tw/fPumY) does not carry the promo code, so paste it or type GHKQF in exactly as shown in the app’s “Enter promo code” screen. This site did not test whether the app fills it in automatically, and nobody registered to test whether the code is accepted.

The share text says 現賺$120點直接折抵 (earn 120 points to offset directly), and the amount is points, not cash. The invite page title says 現賺$100 while its body says 現賺 $120, and the page does not explain the difference; this site follows the share text and the page body at 120 points, and Gomaji’s official announcements prevail on the actual amount.

The invite page says 首次下載 APP (first app download); it states no deadline and does not say whether a returning user who reinstalls qualifies. The help page warns that misusing invite codes can lead to account suspension and clawback of points.

gmj.tw is Gomaji’s short-link domain: Gomaji’s own help page uses it for the app download link, and opened in a browser on 2026-10-24, gmj.tw/fPumY was confirmed to redirect to gomaji.com/invite?code=GHKQF; the domain registration record was not checked. The destination of a short link can be changed by its owner, so check the final address before continuing. Under Gomaji’s terms, users under 18 need a legal guardian to read and agree to the terms.

q.zh-TW: Gomaji 的優惠碼 GHKQF 要在哪裡輸入？
q.en: Where do I enter Gomaji promo code GHKQF?

a.zh-TW: 優惠碼是 GHKQF，不在本站的連結裡：點擊「立即註冊」會先複製優惠碼，再開啟邀請頁。下載 App 後，依 Gomaji 官方說明頁，到「功能列 / 我的 / 賺取點數 / 輸入優惠碼」貼上；若沒有貼上，請依原樣手動輸入。
a.en: The promo code is GHKQF and it is not part of this site’s link: selecting “Sign up” copies it first, then opens the invite page. After downloading the app, Gomaji’s help page says to enter it under 功能列 / 我的 / 賺取點數 / 輸入優惠碼 (menu / Me / Earn points / Enter promo code); paste it, or type it in exactly as shown.

q.zh-TW: 輸入優惠碼可以得到什麼，點數怎麼使用？
q.en: What do I get with the promo code, and how are the points used?

a.zh-TW: 依分享文案與邀請頁內文，首次下載 App 並輸入優惠碼 GHKQF 可得 120 點；邀請頁的標題與內文金額不同（$100 與 $120），實際金額以官方公告為準。依 Gomaji 官方說明頁，1 點等於 NT$1，點數最多折抵折扣後商品金額的 10%，入帳後 30 天內有效，不可轉讓或兌換現金；這類輸入邀請碼的活動，每位用戶僅可擇一參加一次。
a.en: According to the share text and the invite page body, entering promo code GHKQF on a first app download gives 120 points; the invite page shows different amounts in its title and body ($100 and $120), so the official announcements prevail on the actual amount. Gomaji’s help page says 1 point equals NT$1, points offset at most 10% of the discounted product amount, are valid for 30 days after crediting, and cannot be transferred or cashed out; each user can join only one of these code-entry activities, once.
